name: idc-anti-pd-1-lung
description: This collection includes 46 lung cases treated with anti-PD1 immunotherapy in 2016, each with pre-treatment imaging (CT,PT,SC) and most with 1 imaging follow-up timepoint. Please see the Anti-PD-1_Lung wiki page to learn more about the images and to obtain any supporting metadata for this collection.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
